0: Followed a scent through the trees.
Something watched from the ridge. Did not follow.
Old campfire. Cold for weeks. Someone was here.
Wind shifted. Catalogued seven new smells.
Fog sat low. Walked through it anyway.
A sound like digging, far off. Not me.
The trees here grow wrong. Filed for later.
Crossed the creek twice. Lost count after that.
Scent of iron in the air. Getting closer.
1: Trail led into country I had never walked. The country was patient about it.
Old bones in a clearing. Big bones. Walked around them.
Found a stream the wolves of some other pack had marked. Did not add to the marks.
Hills the trail had not warned about. Climbed them anyway.
Scent of something larger than usual. Stayed downwind.
Found tracks of three things, going the same way. Followed the freshest set.
An old kill in a hollow. Picked clean. The forest is thorough.
Walked through a clearing where the grass had been laid flat. Did not stop walking.
Heard a stag bell, far off. The forest answered with something I did not recognize.
Deeper now. The trees know they have not been visited recently.
2: The far country. No paths. Made one.
Trees here older than language. The hunt is what it is anyway.
Found a print larger than my whole paw. Did not follow.
The wind here carries scents I do not have names for.
Walked a ridge where the sky and the forest met without a horizon.
Spoor of things that are not in any wolf's lessons. Worked around them.
Heard a voice in the timber that was not a voice. Did not approach.
Came on an old shrine the forest had grown back into. Did not disturb it.
The trees keep score. I am still ahead.
Some country a wolf walks through, not in. Walked through this country.

light: Got bit. Not badly. Kept going.
Wrong side of a ravine. Had to double back.
Something stirred in the brush. Moved on.
Brambles thick as fence. Got through. Got scratched.
Bee swarm near the trail. Took a different trail.
Quarry doubled back on me. Smart prey. Caught up eventually.
Snare set in the path. Sprung it from a distance. Not mine.
Slipped down a bank, came up muddy. The mud washed off, mostly.
moderate: §c§lThree of them§l at once. Held the ground, cleared it.
§cCornered briefly. §oSmelled the gap before I saw it.§o Found the way out.
§cTook a hit. §oBlood-taste in the mouth.§o Kept moving.
§c§lPack of five§l on the trail. Fell back, regrouped, moved on.
§cTwo scents, both closing. §oNeither one patient.§o Ran the gap between them.
§c§lBear§l in the path. Convinced it I was not worth the trouble. It agreed.
§cQuarry larger than I had read. Worked harder. Got it sorted.
§cGot the tooth in deep. §oBlood-smell on the fur for hours.§o Kept the tooth.
§cFalling branch overhead. §oHeard it crack before it went.§o Stepped clear.
§c§lCreeper§l on the downwind side. Heard the hiss, ran before the count finished.
severe: §c§lToo many§l at once. Barely got clear.
§cHeard the pack split to flank me before I saw them move. Ran the center. Outpaced them.
§c§lSkeleton§l had the high ground and used it. §oArrow in the shoulder.§o Closed the distance fast.
§cThe pack was bigger than it looked. Ran before they could finish the count.
§cSmelled blood on the wind — mine — before I understood the fight was that bad. Fought clear.
§cGot the ground knocked out. §oWorld tilted wrong.§o Came up swinging anyway.
§cThe forest was not on my side today. §oEvery scent was wrong.§o Came home with proof.
§c§lWitch§l at close range. §oSmell of potions, sharp and sweet.§o Took the hit, ran harder.
§cOut of cover and out of options. Made one. It worked.

no_tool: Nothing to fight with. Turning around.
Out of steel. Going back to the bed.
precious_break: Sword too good to lose here. Heading back with it.
Cannot let the enchanted blade end this way. Coming home.
Will not spend the last of this one on a bad fight. Going home with it.
Worth too much to lose to one encounter. Bringing it back.
The good blade stays whole. Setting the hunt down.
broken: Blade snapped on a hard parry. Done.
Hit something harder than the blade was. The blade lost.
Snapped at the worst moment. Gone.
last_gone: End of the blades. Walking back.
Last of the swords spent. Turning toward the bed.
Nothing left to fight with. Going home.
switched_spare: Set down the worn blade. Picked up the next.
Spare sword in the bag. Using it now.
Old blade aside. New blade in paw.
Picked up the second sword. Carried on.
nearly_done: Blade worn thin. Going home before it gives.
Last few fights left in this one. Saving them.
Sword is close to spent. Coming back before it finishes.
Almost nothing left. Coming back with what's there.
